Plain answers, no fog

Brief notes on keys, visibility, funding.

Only you. Your wallet's signature derives the vault key; staff cannot move funds or request recovery phrases.

Observers learn only that a vault exists. Figures, counterparties and holdings stay sealed.

Typing it unlocks a staged empty vault, so coerced access reveals nothing.

Planned: pick any token, enter an amount, approve once while conversion runs behind it.

DexScreener supplies boosts and pairs; pump.fun adds token art after our address goes public. Polling halts while this tab hides.
